title: fix(plugin-form): a wizard goes back to its loading state when it is pointed at another record (objectui#10726)
body:
Fixes #10726

Clause-②: no

Dispatched by the `domain:ui` seat 5 (claim comment 5851765092), session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01KUxVUa7e39aNjhkKi1gsoy`. Base `5c61e5241`. `origin/main` `c3a26ccda` (PR objectui#10730, `packages/types` and `packages/plugin-kanban` only) is merged in as `6d66f607b`.

## What changed

- `packages/plugin-form/src/WizardForm.tsx`, the record effect. A new `loadedRecordIdRef` holds the record id that `formData` was last read for. It is a `React.useRef`, the spelling this file already uses for `seededRef` and `loadedRecordRef`. Before `findOne`, the effect calls `setLoading(true)` when `schema.recordId` differs from that ref. A run that is not superseded sets the ref once its read lands. This is the swap shape of `TabbedForm` and `SplitForm`, and the loading half of what `DrawerForm` and `ModalForm` do.
- Unchanged: the create / no-`recordId` / no-data-source branch, which returns before the new line. Also unchanged: PR objectui#10723's `cancelled` guard, PR objectui#10704's failure slots (`beginLoadRun`), the effect's dependency list, every prop and every export. The other five layouts are untouched.
- `packages/plugin-form/src/recordSwapLoading.test.tsx`. `WizardForm` is a row of the `recordId` swap table, so both of the table's cases run for it: `does not keep showing the previous record while the new one loads` and `ignores a stale response that lands after a newer one`. Two wizard controls are added:
  - `never takes a create wizard back to loading, including when its record effect re-runs`: the step input keeps its element identity across a re-run, and `findOne` is never called.
  - `keeps the step form mounted while the same record is read again`: a rebuilt `initialValues` re-reads r1, and the step input keeps its element identity.
- `.changeset/10726-wizard-swap-loading.md`: `'@object-ui/plugin-form': patch`.

## Measurements

**H1, confirmed.** A throwaway probe went through `SchemaRenderer` and `object-form` on base `5c61e5241`. It was deleted and never committed. `r1` lands, then a re-render to `r2` with its read held:

| Layout | Input while `r2` is held | Loading state shown | After `r2` lands |
|---|---|---|---|
| wizard | `"One"` | no | `"Two"` |
| drawer | `null` | yes | `"Two"` |
| default arm | `null` | yes | `"Two"` |

**H2: what a swap resets.** `DrawerForm` and `ModalForm` reset `loading` and `isDirty`. `isDirty` feeds their unsaved-input guard. `SplitForm` and `TabbedForm` reset `loading` only. `WizardForm` has no dirty state: `isDirty`, `onDirtyChange` and `beforeunload` have zero hits in the file. So only `loading` is reset here. `formData`, `persistedRecord` and the save baseline are replaced when the new read lands, as before.

The wizard also has step state that the other layouts do not keep at component level: `currentStep`, `completedSteps` and `invalidSteps`. `TabbedForm`'s live tab lives in the inner renderer, so the loading branch unmounts it. The same probe measured a two-step wizard on base:

- On step 2 of `r1`, a swap to `r2` with the read held: step 2 still drew `r1`'s value (`"Note one"`). That is this defect.
- After `r2` lands: the counter stays `Step 2 of 2`, step 1 keeps its completed tick, and step 2 reads `"Note two"`. Back to step 1 reads `"Two"`.

⇒ The step state draws no `r1` value once `r2` lands, because every step reads its values from `formData`. The ruling's condition for a step reset is not met, so none was added. The four-axis reading is in the report.

**H3, held.** The new line sits after the create branch's `return`. The create-wizard control pins that its record effect re-runs without a loading state.

## Tests

Every result below was read from a run at the head `6d66f607b` unless it says otherwise. The merge that made `6d66f607b` changes nothing under `packages/plugin-form` (`git diff 9cb52230f 6d66f607b -- packages/plugin-form` is empty). Exit codes were captured before any pipe.

- `pnpm exec vitest run --reporter=verbose packages/plugin-form/src/recordSwapLoading.test.tsx` (with the fix, at `9cb52230f`): exit 0, `Tests 15 passed (15)`.
- **Base leg** (run at `d52ec8be1` and again at `9cb52230f`, the same reading both times): the committed test file against base `WizardForm.tsx`, written from `git show 5c61e5241:…`. Result: vitest exit 1, `Tests 1 failed | 14 passed (15)`.
  - The failing test is `does not keep showing the previous record while the new one loads`, in the `WizardForm — recordId swap` row, with `AssertionError: expected 'Record One' not to be 'Record One'`. All other rows passed, including the drawer control.
  - Mutation proof: the on-disk blob equals the base blob `7ec1efefa021`, and the marker `loadedRecordIdRef` count is 0.
  - Restore proof: `git checkout HEAD --` on an absolute path, then blob `eafcd9471345` equals HEAD's, `git diff HEAD` is empty, and the marker count is 3.
- **Ablation leg** (run at `d52ec8be1` and again at `9cb52230f`, the same reading both times, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in `../objectstack`). The same-record guard was dropped: the anchor `if (loadedRecordIdRef.current !== schema.recordId) setLoading(true);` was replaced by an unconditional, marked `setLoading(true);`.
  - Result: vitest exit 1, `Tests 1 failed | 14 passed (15)`. The failing test is `keeps the step form mounted while the same record is read again`, in `WizardForm — a re-run for the same record`, with `expected null to be` the drawn input. The swap row stays green.
  - The tool's proofs: anchor 1 → 0, replacement 0 → 1, blob `eafcd9471345` → `9c56218f6046`. The restore went back to the HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty.
  - The first attempt was refused by the tool and ran no test: its replacement text was a substring of the anchor, so the replacement count rose by 0. It is not a reading.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-form/`: exit 0, `Test Files 130 passed (130)`, `Tests 1484 passed | 1 skipped (1485)`.
- `pnpm turbo run type-check --filter @object-ui/plugin-form --concurrency=2`: exit 0, `Tasks: 13 successful, 13 total`, with `@object-ui/plugin-form:type-check` a cache miss, so it really ran. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` lists `recordSwapLoading.test.tsx` and `WizardForm.tsx`, so the test half of that script covers the edited test.
- `pnpm exec eslint` on the two changed source files: exit 0, 0 errors.
  - Warnings by rule equal base: `WizardForm.tsx` has 17 `no-explicit-any`, 2 `exhaustive-deps`, 1 `immutability` and 1 `preserve-manual-memoization`. `recordSwapLoading.test.tsx` has 4 `no-explicit-any`. `--format json` reports 2 files linted.
  - The narrowing holds: `eslint.config.js` sets no `parserOptions.project` or `projectService`, so type-aware linting is off and this diff cannot move another file's verdict. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` belongs to CI.
- All exit 0: `pnpm check:control-bytes`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:new-line-citations` (`0 new citation(s)`), `check:changeset-claims` (report-only) and `check:pending-changeset-literals`. `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` also exits 0, with `2 source file(s) of 1 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s)`. Added from the workflows against this diff, all exit 0: `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs`, `check-changeset-fixed.mjs` and `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs`.

## Acceptance notes

- `check:changeset-claims` names `.changeset/6237-wizard-step-config-split.md`, because it names `WizardForm.tsx`. I re-read it. Its paragraph is about `WizardStepConfig` being declared in this file, and this change does not touch that type, so it stays true.
- Observation, not filed. The swap key compares `recordId` only, as on every sectioned layout. So an `objectName` change that keeps the same `recordId`, or an edit → create → same-record sequence on a mounted form, does not go back to loading. No probe was run. This card does not reach it.
- objectui#10715 also names `WizardForm.tsx`. It remains open, and the seat holds it until this lands.
- No governed surface is touched (`AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `.claude/**`, `skills/**`, `docs/adr/**`).
